title: The one AI dashboard: agree on this shape before it is built

owner_note.text: Proposal: the AI Inbox becomes the one list, read from the one state, with chips for Live, New, Recent, Older and Needs you; the tasks page, /tasks/, /live/ and the undone asks page keep their URLs as saved filters of that list. Say yes, or name the chips and the page you want, by voice; nothing is built until then.
